Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)

# Description: Rent lifecycle management

## 2. Rent Lifecycle Management

## 2.1 Rent Creation
## 2.1.1 The system shall allow authenticated users to create a rent request for an available rentable item.
## 2.1.2 The system shall require the user to select the rentable item when creating a rent request.
## 2.1.3 The system shall require the user to provide a rental start date and rental end date.
## 2.1.4 The system shall validate that all required fields are provided before creating the rent request.
## 2.1.5 The system shall assign a unique identifier to each rent record.
